segments.he: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַב: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, וְלָא מִטַּעְמֵיהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:» Even if he wrote: I have no claim to your property, or to its produce, or to the produce of its produce, in your lifetime and after your death, he nevertheless inherits from her. This is because his condition is void, as it runs counter to what is written in the Torah. «Rav said:» The «halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel» that a husband inherits from his wife, «but not» because of «his» line of «reasoning.»
